summary: The appeal challenged the Madhya Pradesh High Court's decision setting aside an order that allowed temporary teachers to continue till regular appointments. The Supreme Court upheld continuation of appellants as ad hoc appointees till regular selection, subject to student enrollment, but rejected entitlement to UGC-specified salaries, allowing honorarium as per committee determination. The appeals were partly allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Rattan Lal and others vs. State of Haryana and others, (1985) 4 SCC 43
Hargurpratap Singh vs. State of Punjab and others, (2007) 13 SCC 292
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; impugned High Court judgment set aside; single judge's order modified to allow continuation of appellants till regular appointments and based on student strength, with honorarium at Rs. 1,000 per hour.
